pad_kernel.scope: Existing actual inference trace. Kernel function samples on identified pad fetch and delivery threads. User stacks were not captured.
limitations: Inclusive function counts overlap within callstacks; do not sum them as separate CPU or wall costs.
User CPU samples lack callstacks because userspace unwinding was disabled; unknown userspace work is not zero.
App BENCH receipt windows are not exact guest clock boundaries. First trial start is partially excluded by recorder startup.

measurement_limit: No matching v43 0/0 control yet; no isolated speed improvement claim.
